message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Docs

on:
  # Runs on pushes targeting the default branch
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
      - "docs/**"
      - "CONSTRUCT.md"
      - "constructor/construct.py"

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Allow one concurrent deployment
concurrency:
  group: pages-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -el {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Cache conda packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/conda/pkgs
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-conda-${{ hashFiles('docs/environment.yml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-conda-

      - uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@be893c923ea9cf1cf7cd510fbdde27c7e18cbdcb # v4.1.0
        with:
          activate-environment: constructor-docs
          environment-file: docs/environment.yml
          python-version: '3.11'
          auto-activate-base: false

      - name: Build Documentation
        run: |
          cd docs
          make dirhtml

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          # Upload entire repository
          path: 'docs/_build/dirhtml'

  pages:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: [docs]

    # Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}

    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5.0.1",
  "rationale": "Add a dependency-download cache for the conda environment (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). The workflow repeatedly fetches conda dependencies from docs/environment.yml on every run and currently has no cache step. Restoring the conda package cache keyed on docs/environment.yml, with a prefix restore key, reuses dependency downloads across runs while a changed environment file invalidates the cache, so installation and the full docs build still execute and coverage is preserved. Only dependency downloads are cached, not build outputs, and no permissions, secrets, publishing, or deployment behavior are changed.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
